name: New Relic
short: Full-stack observability platform (APM, logs, infrastructure, Kubernetes, synthetics, errors inbox, dashboards) with 100 GB/mo free ingest, unlimited basic users, and one full-platform user.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 100 GB data ingest per month (metrics, events, logs, traces from any source), one full-platform user with access to 50+ capabilities, unlimited basic users (query, dashboards, alerts), default logs obfuscation (CC/SSN), 8-day retention, 500 synthetic ping checks, no credit card.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Up to 5 full-platform users, ticketed support, SAML SSO; $0.40/GB beyond the free 100 GB; usage-based ingest.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Unlimited full-platform users, extended data retention, advanced admin capabilities, SAML SSO; for scaling teams.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Unlimited full-platform users, FedRAMP/HIPAA compliance, 24/7 dedicated support, Data Plus and advanced security.
